stable.notes: Keeps Nia Solari, Elara Vale and Rowan Vale animated with quiet open sessions and while waiting. Those runtime states previously loaded a legacy still instead of the approved eight-frame idle. Shared calm clips keep their authored cadence without duplicate playlist resets. Native canary checks cover all four Jedi across no-session, quiet and waiting states. Exact-stock 0.5.151/0.5.152 and older packs upgrade automatically; custom art, timing, scale and saved settings are preserved. All artwork, combat loops, Miles Windu V15.4 and his 1.30x idle remain unchanged. Pairs with server 6.41.0.

notice.title: One last Accessibility toggle
notice.body: This update changes how COS Control is signed so macOS keeps your Accessibility permission across future updates. macOS drops the old grant one final time: open System Settings, Privacy & Security, Accessibility, toggle COS Control off and on, then reopen COS Control. You will not need to do this again.
